readings: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average absolute difference between CPU usage and GPU usage (|`proccpu` − `procgpu`|, regardless of which is larger), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref,
         s.insurstat AS insurstat,
         AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remain,
         AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
m AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_avg FROM g
)
SELECT g.zoneref,
       g.insurstat,
       g.avg_remain,
       g.avg_diff,
       g.avg_remain * 1.0 / m.mean_avg AS ratio
FROM g, m
WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
